article.title: Hepatitis C virus infection and cognitive outcomes in adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
article.authors: Guevara-Tirado A, Barra GG, Tineo JCB
article.abstract: Hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection has been linked to cognitive outcomes, but evidence remains heterogeneous and may be influenced by liver disease severity.
